targets.rawSql:
SELECT id, provider, parent_ref, poi_id, active, next_run_at, last_run_at, consecutive_failures, cadence_override_sec, updated_at
FROM availability_poller
WHERE ${poller_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND id::text = ${poller_id:sqlstring};

SELECT
  w.id AS watch_id,
  w.status AS watch_status,
  CASE
    WHEN count(DISTINCT wt.id) = 0 THEN NULL
    WHEN count(DISTINCT wt.id) FILTER (WHERE wt.poi_id IS NOT NULL) > 0
     AND count(DISTINCT wt.id) FILTER (WHERE wt.campsite_id IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'mixed'
    WHEN count(DISTINCT wt.id) FILTER (WHERE wt.poi_id IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'poi'
    ELSE 'campsite'
  END AS scope,
  count(DISTINCT wt.id) AS target_count,
  array_agg(
    DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN wt.poi_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'poi:' || wt.poi_id::text
      WHEN wt.campsite_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'campsite:' || wt.campsite_id::text
    END
  ) FILTER (WHERE wt.id IS NOT NULL) AS scope_ids,
  w.campsite_filters,
  w.start_date,
  w.end_date,
  w.cadence_sec,
  w.trigger_kinds,
  w.stop_when_triggered,
  count(DISTINCT p.id) AS pollers,
  min(p.next_run_at) FILTER (WHERE p.active) AS next_run_at,
  max(p.last_run_at) AS last_run_at,
  w.created_at
FROM availability_watch w
LEFT JOIN availability_watch_poller wp ON wp.watch_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN availability_poller p ON p.id = wp.poller_id
LEFT JOIN availability_watch_target wt ON wt.watch_id = w.id
GROUP BY w.id, w.status, w.campsite_filters, w.start_date, w.end_date, w.cadence_sec, w.trigger_kinds, w.stop_when_triggered, w.created_at
ORDER BY (w.status = 'active') DESC, next_run_at ASC NULLS LAST;
